title: AUSpeech: An Audio-Ultrasound Synchronized Tongue Movement Database for Mandarin speech
why_promising: Primary synchronized Mandarin audio plus ultrasound tongue imaging from 54 participants (43 healthy, 11 dysarthric). The project documents .wav, .dcm, .lab and .TextGrid data. Normal-subject MFA alignments were followed by manual labeling checks for verification, while patient pronunciation labels were manually annotated, making human-verified and manually created layers potentially eligible for acoustic/articulatory/clinical production tables.
open_question: Repository currently exposes code/examples rather than the approximately 700 GB corpus itself. Need locate authoritative data-access endpoint and license, enumerate available files, determine whether manual verification was exhaustive per normal-speaker file/tier, isolate manually annotated patient pronunciation labels from automatic alignment products, and verify whether ultrasound contours/landmarks or only raw DICOM frames are distributed.
